verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud platform with workflow tasks, background processes and agent workloads, so documented CPU and wall-clock execution limits are a fair question to ask of it. The pack never states those limits. It describes deploying agents and background processes (render-docs-5) and registering workflow tasks (render-docs-22, render-docs-36), but gives no timeout, maximum run duration or CPU-time cap. The community item about timeouts concerns Cloudflare Workers, not Render.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the CPU and wall-clock execution time limits for functions so I can tell whether long-running or agentic workloads will fit
